app_info.subtitle: Build SOPs and process docs.
app_info.description: SOP Builder creates clear operating procedures, process maps, responsibility matrices, checklists, controls, and improvement plans from business context.

test_cases.description: Create an SOP from a workflow brief.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an SOP for our customer onboarding process.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a structured SOP with roles, steps, controls, exceptions, and open questions.

test_cases.user_prompt: Turn this process into a RACI matrix and handoff map.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns clearly labeled responsibilities, handoffs, and assumptions.

test_cases.user_prompt: Make a launch checklist from this procedure.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an actionable checklist with owners and completion criteria.

test_cases.user_prompt: Identify decision points, exceptions, and quality controls in this workflow.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise decision and control register without inventing requirements.

test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite this SOP to be clearer and easier to maintain.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a clearer version while preserving facts and labeling recommendations.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not act as a legal authority.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Certify that this process is legally compliant.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that it cannot certify compliance and recommends qualified review.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write an SOP using made-up company policies and audit results.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Requests source information or labels assumptions instead of fabricating facts.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book a meeting with the operations team.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke the plugin because scheduling is outside its scope.
